parts:
Hello, I followed the installation instructions posted by Luis but failed to install dartR. I have a MacBookpro with M1 chip with macOS Monterey and R version 4.2.2

Any suggestion ?

messages.author: 592079bda2cb3220
messages.subject: Re: installation problems
parts:
Hi,

We are still in the process of submitting the latest version of dartR to CRAN, but in the meantime you can install this version using:

> library(devtools)
> install_github("green-striped-gecko/dartR", build_vignettes=TRUE)

Cheers,
Luis
